name: Aquatics Junior Lifeguard
what_you_do: Volunteer at Mesa pools in summer. You build the skills and attitude to become a lifeguard later.
who_can_apply: Ages 13 to 16. You must swim 50 yards, tread water for 60 seconds and swim 10 yards underwater.
pay_detail: Volunteer role. The page says it leads to future lifeguarding.
duration: Summer, at least 30 volunteer hours. Exact dates not listed.
deadline_text: No dates posted. The page gives only the season.
how_to_apply: Use the sign-up link for Junior Lifeguards. The page does not say if sign-up is open. Questions: 480-644-7529 or aquatics@mesaaz.gov.
notes: Part of the City of Mesa H.Y.P.E. Teen Programs page. That page says ages 13 to 15, but the Junior Lifeguarding page says 13 to 16. Confirm your age fits.
